decisions.reason: As a surviving handle family close to the core business, it benefits from prior line investment and portfolio continuity, so management is inclined to keep it unless clear weakness forces pruning.

This design is less strategically central and likely less heavily invested in than a full system family, but because it remained after the first review period and fits the established offer, management would still tend to continue it.

Because this electronic access system is a publicly presented flagship tied to the firm's stated digital direction and has absorbed substantial development effort, management is especially likely to persist with it and attribute any shortfall to temporary market factors.
